apps.name: JellyMuse
apps.localizedDescription: Jellyfin Music Client that mimics Apple Music

versions.localizedDescription:
Lyrics rebuilt for smoother scrolling and line changes.

• New lyrics engine, now the default for both plain and word-synced lyrics
• Karaoke wipe, duets, background vocals, intro/interlude dots and stepped blur, matching Apple Music
• Pronunciation under each word (Japanese, Chinese, Korean) and translations under each line, including for background vocals
• Arabic and Hebrew lyrics drawn right to left, with a left-to-right pronunciation row
• Tap highlight now fits each line with its translation and pronunciation
• Fixes: wipe after seeking back, last line staying lit, early-lit pronunciation letters, long-note swell on mixed-language lines, and tapping to show the controls no longer jumps to a lyric
